role: The app's whole strap surface (17 calls) as the StrapRadio protocol, and StrapAPI, the production conformer that forwards live HR to StandardHeartRateLink and every other call to the Polar SDK; tests substitute FakeStrapRadio via PolarManager.radioForTesting.
types: StrapRadio: protocol (Sendable) — connection, streaming, H10 exercise and Verity offline-recording calls
StrapAPI: struct (StrapRadio, @unchecked Sendable) — wraps PolarBleApi + StandardHeartRateLink
toplevel: Whole file under #if canImport(PolarBleSdk). StrapAPI instances are built per access by PolarManager.strapAPI (PolarManager.swift:436).
